name: Jatin Das
contribution: Jatin Das joined revolutionary anti-colonial politics and died after a prolonged hunger strike in Lahore jail in 1929.
context: Revolutionary politics, colonial imprisonment, and political hunger strikes in late-colonial India.
impact: His death turned the prison hunger strike into a powerful symbol of resistance to colonial incarceration.
highlight: Jatin Das became a symbol of anti-colonial protest through his 1929 hunger strike in Lahore jail.
seoTitle: Jatin Das: Hunger Strike and Anti-Colonial Resistance
seoDescription: Explore Jatin Das's revolutionary politics and the 1929 Lahore jail hunger strike that made him a symbol of resistance.
shortAnswer: Jatin Das was an anti-colonial revolutionary who died after a hunger strike in Lahore jail in 1929.
